description: LUTGPT 84.94M params (E=96, d_v=16, H=6, L=6). Lightweight two-phase 16K-step recipe. Phase A (steps 1-8000): bs=8, forward_mode='hybrid_smooth' (top-2 smooth forward + soft backward). Phase B (steps 8001-16000): bs=16, forward_mode='hard' (single-row sign-pack forward + soft backward). Both switches happen simultaneously at step 8000 (bs_switch_step == hard_switch_step). LR schedule is continuous over 16K with 10% warmup (1600 steps) followed by cosine decay to 0.1*peak. Compute: Phase A = 8K * 4096 = 32.8M tokens; Phase B = 8K * 8192 = 65.5M tokens; total 98.3M tokens.
